def project_scope_aliases(project, scope, index=None):
    """Bind a CRM project number/ID pair before accepting either policy name.

    A numeric scope already names the native project. Resolving a project-ID
    scope additionally needs the complete project inventory and its successful
    same-scope CRM read, rather than a coincidentally matching projectId field.
    """
    name = get(project, 'name', str)
    if not re.fullmatch(r'projects/[1-9][0-9]*', name):
        raise Unavailable('native numeric project identity unavailable')
    project_id = _optional(project, 'projectId', '', str)
    if project_id and not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9-]{4,28}[a-z0-9]', project_id):
        raise Unavailable('native project ID malformed')
    aliases = {name.split('/', 1)[1]}
    if project_id:
        aliases.add(project_id)
    if scope == name:
        return aliases
    if not project_id or scope != 'projects/' + project_id or index is None:
        raise Unavailable('project identity differs from scope')
    context = get(index, 'context', dict)
    if get(context, 'provider', str) != 'gcp' or get(context, 'scope', str) != scope:
        raise Unavailable('project alias context differs from scope')
    provenance = get(project, '_provenance', dict)
    if (get(provenance, 'scope', str) != scope
            or get(project, 'native_id', str) != name
            or get(project, '_resource_id', str) != name):
        raise Unavailable('project alias native provenance differs from scope')
    metadata = get(context, 'metadata', dict)
    if get(provenance, 'collected_at', str) != get(metadata, 'asset_read_time', str):
        raise Unavailable('project alias evidence is not from this collection')
    refs = get(provenance, 'source_requests', list)
    if not refs or any(not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref for ref in refs):
        raise Unavailable('project alias source requests unavailable')
    envelopes = get(index, 'collections.project', list)
    if len(envelopes) != 1:
        raise Unavailable('project alias inventory ambiguous')
    envelope = envelopes[0]
    if (get(envelope, 'type', str) != 'project' or get(envelope, 'scope', str) != scope
            or get(envelope, 'status', str) != 'collected'
            or get(envelope, 'coverage_status', str) != 'collected'
            or get(envelope, 'items', list) != [project]
            or not set(refs) <= set(get(envelope, 'source_requests', list))):
        raise Unavailable('project alias inventory incomplete or inconsistent')
    requests = list_of_objects(get(metadata, 'source_requests', list))
    request_ids = [get(row, 'id', str) for row in requests]
    if len(set(request_ids)) != len(request_ids):
        raise Unavailable('project alias request identities ambiguous')
    crm_url = 'https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v3/' + scope
    if not any(row['id'] in refs and row.get('method') == 'GET'
               and row.get('url') == crm_url and row.get('scope') == scope
               and row.get('status') == 'collected' for row in requests):
        raise Unavailable('successful same-scope CRM project read unavailable')
    return aliases

gcp.ports.iam_api_key_restricts_apis.defect: Case-sensitive wildcard comparison accepted CLOUDAPIS.GOOGLEAPIS.COM as a restriction.
gcp.ports.iam_api_key_restricts_apis.correction: Canonicalize each readable target service through the existing canonical_target DNS validator before wildcard comparison; evidence names are canonicalized too.
gcp.ports.iam_api_key_restricts_apis.limits: Declared API target restrictions only; does not establish actual key use, caller restrictions, method least privilege or effective access.

gcp.ports.apikeys_api_restricted_with_ge.defect: Mixed uppercase Gemini targets and uppercase cloudapis bypassed enabled-Gemini restrictions.
gcp.ports.apikeys_api_restricted_with_ge.correction: Reuse canonical_target on the native API target service values; preserve the existing exact service-state/scope join and disabled-Gemini applicability.
gcp.ports.apikeys_api_restricted_with_ge.limits: Target declarations only; project alias production and enabled service state do not prove current key activity.

gcp_cloudsql_backup_failure_alert.defect: The bound _backup_alert required native project.name == selected scope, so ordinary CRM numeric project names rejected a matching selected project ID before evaluating valid backup alerts.
gcp_cloudsql_backup_failure_alert.correction: Retain _base unique scoped inventory validation and delegate identity validation to configured_alerts via index=index; project_scope_aliases accepts project-ID scopes only with native number/ID, exact inventory, fresh same-scope provenance and successful CRM request proof.
alias_proof: Numeric native CRM name and syntactically valid projectId match the selected project ID.
Native identity fields and provenance scope agree with the CRM name and exact scope.
Project provenance collection time matches metadata.asset_read_time.
One collected project envelope has exactly that project and owns its request references.
A uniquely identified successful GET receipt targets https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v3/{selected_scope} with that exact scope.
gcp_cloudsql_backup_failure_alert.preserved_contract: Numeric-scope helper calls retain their prior independent project metadata interface; the new strong proof is required to resolve project-ID scopes. Existing direct helper unit tests and numeric native pipeline remain green.
gcp_cloudsql_backup_failure_alert.limits: The helper still has a bounded final scheduled-backup failure contract; complex filters, AND gating and unproved thresholds remain UNKNOWN. No event generation, incident creation, notification delivery or effective access is assessed.
